title: FAQ: Teen Checking Accounts
summary: This FAQ explains teen checking account conversion at eligibility (automatic if “Yes is True,” otherwise the change must be initiated), and it lists fees for a returned deposit check ($12.50) and incoming domestic wire transfers ($10.00).
